Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating the availability of aerospace tax incentives for airplane manufacturers transferring substantial manufacturing operations to other states.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to eliminating the availability of aerospace taxincentives for airplane manufacturers transferring substantialmanufacturing operations to other states; and adding a new section tochapter 82.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person manufacturing commercial airplanes in this state maynot claim any aerospace tax incentive if more than fifty percent of thefinal assembly of any commercial airplane family manufactured by theperson occurs outside the state of Washington. (2) The definitions in this subsection apply to this section. (a) "Aerospace tax incentive" means a tax exemption, deduction,credit, or preferential tax rate in RCW 82.04.260(11), 82.04.4463,82.04.4461, 82.08.975, 82.08.980, 82.12.975, and 82.12.980. (b) "Final assembly" means the activity of assembling an airplanefrom components parts necessary for its mechanical operation such thatthe finished commercial airplane is ready to deliver to the ultimateconsumer. p. 1 HB 3107 (3) This section applies to a person on the first day of the firstreporting period occurring after the condition in subsection (1) ofthis section is met.
